content: YouTube Data API quota (verified 2026-06 page): default allocation is 100 search.list calls/day in a dedicated bucket, 100 videos.insert/day, 10,000 units/day combined for other endpoints; every request even invalid costs at least 1 unit; each additional results page costs a full search. Quota resets midnight PT. Quota extension requires API Compliance Audit approval. Google best practices: do not embed API keys in code, restrict keys to specific APIs and apps, rotate periodically. YouTube Developer Policies III.D.1.c: exactly one API project per API client, credentials must not be shared with third parties or embedded in open source projects.
